text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Councillor Robinson, during the afternoon session of the meeting, welcomed the members of the International Women's Association who were present in the Chamber. Councillor Perks, during the afternoon session of the meeting, advised Members of Council that Councillor Sarah Doucette would not be seeking re-election in a 25 Ward model for the City of Toronto. Councillor Perks remarked on Councillor Doucette's dedication to the residents of Ward 13 and thanked her for work to the City of Toronto. Councillor Doucette, during the afternoon session of the meeting, addressed Members of Council and spoke of her work during her eight years of service to the City of Toronto and thanked her residents, Members of Council and her staff for their support.
